title: Semiconductor and AI stocks fall in global markets amid rising financing costs
summary: Tech and chip stocks plunge in the U.S., Europe, and Japan as borrowing costs hit multi-year highs, weighing on sector valuations.

title: Massive global bond sell-off pushes yields to decade highs on inflation fears and AI debt
summary: Fixed income markets suffer a wave of selling that drives yields to levels not seen in 10 years, driven by massive debt issuance for AI infrastructure and inflation concerns.

title: Fund managers raise equity bets to five-year highs despite bond market turmoil
summary: Managers increase equity exposure to levels not seen since 2021, ignoring the bond sell-off and counting on the resilience of corporate earnings.
